label: 22 cc coal rebalance
definition: From the run157-dam-as-overlay keeper, adds reliability_floor and moderates three offer-curve deltas that caused a 2023 LMP collapse in ercot 21 ($28.57 model vs $48.36 actual at $2.54/MWh gas): CC_REGULAR econ_high delta set to -0.10 (halfway between keeper -0.20 and ercot 21 0.0), peak delta +0.25 (between keeper +0.32 and ercot 21 +0.18), and PRB sigmoid floor 0.76 (between keeper 0.78 and ercot 21 0.74). These are offer-curve shape parameters — no adder or haircut fitted to the price residual, all levers have forward analogues. Determination: NOT-YET (C1 ST_GAS 2024 fuel-mix, C2 gas 2025 system volume, and C3b price shape 2023–2024 remain out of band; C3a 2024 mean LMP +8.4% accepted as measured-input limitation per the attestation).
